predictions.articleTitle: Inter Miami vs Columbus Crew Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Crew Exploit Miami's Leaks? — xG Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Inter Miami's intact Messi-led attack and 87.5% home unbeaten record favor Home Win / Draw alongside Over 2.5 Goals and BTTS: Yes.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Thesis: Home Win / Draw — Inter Miami's 1.97 xG per game and 4W-2D home H2H edge support a home victory, while their 56.2% home draw rate merits Draw coverage (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

Secondary Angle: Over 2.5 Goals & BTTS: Yes — Supported by a 3.68 combined lambda, 87.5% home Over 2.5 and BTTS rates for Miami, and 80.0% away Over 2.5 for Columbus (Confidence: High, Value: Moderate)

Contingency Angle: Late 2:2 Equalizer — If Casemiro's center-back deployment concedes transition space to Columbus Crew's bench runners, a four-goal stalemate mirrors their August 2026 meeting (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Messi's intact 4-3-3 attack meets Columbus Crew's surging transition threats.

spf.comment: Covers both the 2:1 home-win script led by Inter Miami's firepower and the 2:2 draw script driven by Miami's 56.2% home draw rate, where a single call ignores their 12.5% home clean-sheet frequency.

over_under.comment: Combined 3.68 lambda, 71.1% Poisson Over 2.5 probability, and 87.5% home / 80.0% away Over 2.5 rates strongly favor three or more goals.

btts.comment: Inter Miami scored in 100% of home league matches against a 20.0% away Crew clean-sheet rate, while Columbus scored in 93.3% of road games against Miami's 12.5% home shutout rate.

score.comment: 2:1 (8.3% density) captures Miami's home attacking edge despite conceding, while 2:2 (7.2% density) reflects their high home draw tendency.

goals.comment: 3 goals (21.0% Poisson probability) and 4 goals (19.3%) lead the total-goal distribution around a 3.68 combined lambda.

bqc.comment: Inter Miami led at half-time in 43.8% of home matches without ever trailing at the break while Columbus trailed at half-time in 46.7% of away trips, yet Miami failed to win 57.1% of their home half-time leads.
